listenings.text: Hi, this is Marcos from purchasing. I have news about the order from France. The material leaves the headquarters on Monday, and it arrives here in three weeks. Our factory starts the production in October. Lucia knows about it, and she talks to the client today. Call me if you need more information. Thank you.

Good morning, this is Claire. In our group, every country works in the same way. The purchasing team buys the raw material. The factory makes the flavor and the fragrance. The shipping team sends the product to the client. Our headquarters supports every country, but the operation is local. Brazil is a strong operation, and it grows every year.

extra_audio.text: Marcos buys the raw material for the factory. The material arrives from France. The factory makes the flavor and the fragrance. Lucia sends the product to the client. The client receives the order in Brazil.

reading.rtitle: Meet the Operation -- Robertet do Brasil
paras: Robertet do Brasil has two divisions. The flavor division makes taste, and the fragrance division makes smell. Our factory is here in Brazil, and our headquarters is in France.
Marcos works in purchasing. He buys the raw material for the two divisions. Some material comes from France. Some material comes from China and India.
Lucia works in shipping. She sends the product to the client. Her team starts at seven in the morning, and it finishes at five in the afternoon.
The Operations Director is responsible for the full supply chain. He works with purchasing, with the factory and with shipping, every day.
